integrity: Exact rational certificate for the Gaussian polynomial fourth norms and algebraic pointwise domination; relies on cited Hilbert-space Korenblum theorem for the lower bound; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Upper obstruction only, not exact sharp radius; no result for all non-Hilbert exponents. Full text of relevant older articles could not be inspected, preserving a historical originality risk.
title: A strict non-monomial upper bound for the quartic Gaussian Fock Korenblum radius
